test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Monumental
solution: The correct answer is '**Monumental**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Monumental**' is '**Insignificant**'. • **Monumental**: very great, large or import ant. (अति विशाल या महत्वपूर्ण, चिरस्‍मरणीय) • *Example: a **monumental** success/task/achievement...* • **Insignificant**: of little value or importance. (महत्वहीन, उपेक्षणीय, नगण्य, निरर्थक) • *Example: an **insignificant** detail...* **Correct Sentence:__** *Monumental.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Mysterious**: that you do not understand or cannot explain; strange. (समझने या समझाने से परे; अद्‌भुत, रहस्‍यमय) • **Important**: having great value or influence; very necessary. (महत्वपूर्ण; अत्‍यावश्‍यक) • **Enormous**: very big or very great. (विशाल या अत्‍यधिक) 202:Ta63, The correct answer is '**Aviary**'.
